# openai_project_model_permissions (Data Source)

Retrieves model access permissions for a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_project_model_permissions" "test" {
  project_id = "proj_abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project for which model permissions are being set.

### Read-Only

- `mode` (String) The model permissions mode to apply. One of `allow_list` or `deny_list`.
- `model_ids` (Set of String) The model IDs included in this permissions policy.
